title: 82627P0002-BEPA: GI-PSE 1-3 Design Services Task Order Contract for Green Infrastructure in NYC Parks & City-owned Street Ends
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text:
The City of New York has a combined sewer system serving approximately one third of the city. During rain events, rainfall is transmitted to the water bodies surrounding the City with limited water quality treatment, contributing to water quality impacts in the receiving water bodies. The scope of GI-PSE 1, 2 and 3 contracts are to design an extensive system of GI practices in NYC Parks and Publicly owned street ends to capture and manage stormwater runoff from impervious surfaces top meet Consent Order requirements. These practices include but are not limited to bioretention systems, permeable pavement, synthetic turf, wetlands, green roofs, subsurface detention/retention systems, and/or any combination thereof.
